summary: saddamchait private family chat app: mobile-first React UI with Login/Signup screens, upgraded Signup form fields (profile photo + relation/age/mobile), password reset UI, and interactive form validation/submit behavior (UI-only in draft; no backend or paid features).

existing_features.title: Motoko backend canister scaffold
existing_features.description: Base Motoko canister source and system IDL wiring suitable for ICP deployment, with generated frontend declarations for actor typing.

existing_features.title: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend scaffold
existing_features.description: React application setup (Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind) with app shell, routing/screens entrypoints, and project config files.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication integration
existing_features.description: Hooks and UI layout/screens for authentication using Internet Identity, including actor initialization support.

existing_features.title: Reusable UI component library (shadcn/ui) included
existing_features.description: Vendored shadcn/ui component set and supporting utilities/config (eslint rules, components.json, utils).

existing_features.title: Build/deploy template and automation scripts
existing_features.description: Build template assets (Dockerfile, deploy.sh, canister yaml templates, workspace/package configs) plus scripts for pruning/resizing images and build orchestration.

existing_features.title: Auth UI screens (login, signup, password reset)
existing_features.description: Frontend screens and layout for user authentication flows, including Login, Signup, and Password Reset screens integrated with existing Internet Identity hooks.

existing_features.title: Camera capture hook and profile image processing utilities
existing_features.description: Client-side camera capture hook plus utilities for processing profile images (e.g., resizing/format handling) to support avatar/profile photo workflows.

existing_features.title: ICP CLI / GitHub export-ready project template configuration
existing_features.description: Provides standardized icp-cli compatible project templates and configs (icp.yaml, per-canister canister.yaml templates, build/deploy scripts and workspace packaging) to support reproducible builds and repository export workflows.

existing_features.title: Wire the green "Signup" button on the Signup screen (frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx) to a real form submit handler so it is never a dead button in draft mode (UI-only; no backend calls).

On Signup submit, validate required fields and show inline error messages next to the corresponding fields when missing/invalid. At minimum, validate all fields that are presented as required in the UI (e.g., fields marked with "*") and any additional signup-critical fields present on the form (email/password/confirm password).

If Signup validation passes (all required fields are filled and valid), show a temporary success response in the UI (no backend). Implement either (A) navigation to a simple "Signup successful / Pending approval" screen/state, or (B) a clear success message on the Signup screen using existing UI components (e.g., shadcn Alert).

new_feature_requests.summary: Upgrade Signup UI: mandatory profile photo with Gallery/Camera, preview, resize/compress constraints (512x512, JPEG 70%, <200KB) and placeholder face-validation messaging
Add Relation field dropdown (Father/Mother/Brother/Sister/Son/Daughter/Other) with conditional custom text input when 'Other' is selected
Add Age field (required) with minimum age 18 and inline validation messaging
Add Mobile Number field (required) with country code selector + number input; relaxed validation to only require 10 digits and mark as 'unverified' (no real-number/carrier validation)
Add Login 'Forgot password?' link and UI-only password reset screen (email input, submit, success placeholder; no backend/email send)

Wire Signup button to real submit handler (UI-only): validate required fields, show inline errors, and on success show temporary success response (message or 'Signup successful / Pending approval' screen)

architectural_notes: Project structured as ICP canisters with separate backend (Motoko) and frontend (React) configurations and generated declaration files for typed actor calls.
Frontend auth uses Internet Identity; custom linting/rules enforce correct II provider usage and avoid problematic query-key bigint usage.
shadcn/ui components are vendored into the repository with shared UI utilities and Tailwind/PostCSS configuration.
Build/deploy is standardized via a build-template (Dockerfile, deploy script, canister yaml templates) and supporting Node scripts (image prune/resize).
Frontend includes a camera capture hook and a dedicated profile image processing utility module for handling user-provided images (e.g., avatars).
Auth UI is implemented as dedicated screens (Login/Signup/Password Reset) layered on top of the existing Internet Identity integration.
Build template now includes icp-cli/GitHub-export oriented configuration (icp.yaml plus per-canister canister.yaml templates) aligned with deploy.sh and workspace packaging for reproducible exports.
Project is a private family chat app (saddamchait) with a strict FREE-only scope: no paid features, no recommendations.
Signup image processing requirements are client-side: resize to max 512x512 (keep aspect ratio), compress to JPEG at ~70% quality, target final size <200KB, and show preview before signup.
Mobile number validation during signup is minimal (10 digits only), numbers are treated as 'unverified' with verification deferred to future scope.
known_issues: Signup button is currently non-functional (no submit handler wired).
